description: Screen companies and portfolios against investment mandates to assess compliance. Access mandates created in the Clarity AI web app, then run compliance reports to identify breaches. Drill into individual companies for detailed evidence across a range of extra-financial metrics. Discover investment universe companies that meet your criteria, and get concise breach summaries across your portfolios, all powered by Clarity AI's data.
